title: No bit-shift expressions
description: Polars's Python expressions have no bit shift: `pl.Expr` has no `__lshift__` or `__rshift__`, and its `bitwise_*` methods are `and`, `or`, `xor` and bit counts. `shift` moves rows.
reference: `shift_left` and `shift_right` (`functions_arithmetic.yaml`), with the range open (ST-1). A plan with them is refused on Polars or written as a multiplication or floor division by a power of two.

provenance.notes: `sverify_dev.probe_polars` runs each expression on edge cases (0, ±1, ±2, 3, ±7, the bounds of the integer width; 0.5, ±2.5, 7, 1e308, ±inf, NaN; NULL), one row at a time, and compares each row with Lean's outcome of the Substrait call under each candidate option (`substrait-check --outcomes`). Observations are Polars programs whose result is recorded as it is. Polars 2.1.0 (Python), Rust crates at tag py-2.1.0 (commit 7f902bd3), on macOS arm64.

evidence.note: Expression operators (API reference, version 2): bitwise `&`, `|`, `^`, `~` and no shift.
`Expr`'s operator dunders at tag py-2.1.0: `__and__`, `__invert__`, `__or__`, `__xor__`, no `__lshift__` or `__rshift__`.

provenance.notes: The API reference's expression operators list `&`, `|`, `^` and `~` as the bitwise operators, with no shift; the `bitwise_*` methods are `and`, `or`, `xor` and bit counts, and `Expr.shift` moves rows. The same holds for every integer type, so the shift rows are settled: Polars has no shift to characterize.

notes: Streaming gives what in memory gives on every probe and observation cited here.
The observation reads the Python API (`dir(pl.Expr)`), which both engines share.

`python -m sverify_dev.probe_polars --diff --write` runs each probe one row at a time and on a 6000-row column with `collect(engine='in-memory')` and `collect(engine='streaming')`, and each observation twice: its `df(...)` frame's `select`, `with_columns`, `filter`, `sort`, `unique`, `join` and `group_by` go through the streaming engine the second time (`StreamingFrame`); the `s-` observations collect a lazy query on each engine themselves. Polars 2.1.0 (Python), macOS arm64.

evidence.note: Operator: no shift; polars-sql has none either
